run_update_meshes: run the script to copy STL mesh files from a robot batch directory into the general meshes folder
review_update_meshes: review the script that reads fleet YAML config and copies batch-specific STL mesh files
refactor_update_meshes: refactor the script to use shutil instead of os.system for copying STL mesh files
summarize_update_meshes: summarize the script that extracts batch_name from stretch_re1_factory_params.yaml and copies corresponding mesh files
test_update_meshes: test the script to verify it correctly reads batch_name and constructs the mesh copy command
